gen-gf-sniglet-gf-tsukimi-rounded: Distinctive and commanding, Sniglet stops its terminals short and keeps a level beat with no weight accents. But Tsukimi Rounded does the quieter work, with round forms like open parentheses and parallel-edged curves.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-tuffy: Pencil-light and contemporary, the text reads smoothly, its s widely parted, under Sniglet's level, blunt-ended heading. Tuffy keeps its pressure constant while Sniglet supplies the personality, so each line has a clear job.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-urbanist: Sniglet stops its terminals short and holds a level beat. Urbanist moves on with a broad-nibbed stroke that never curls shut, as steady as a rolling-ball pen's single-width trail.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-varela: Punchy and level: Sniglet stops its terminals short. What makes the pair work is Varela's sans-serif ease, a t with crossbar and stem sharing one width, c shapes like a wide mouth.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-varela-round: Varela Round reads modern and clean, wide-mouthed in its lowercase. The best thing here is the gap: Sniglet's blunt terminals and level beat above, counters framed by same-width strokes below.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-varta: Varta is a sans-serif with big open eyes on every e and a, built for steady, neutral reading. Sniglet grabs the eye with unmodulated lines; Varta carries the words.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-vazirmatn: Terminals that stop short of curling back in give Sniglet its blunt, commanding look, all on a level beat. Vazirmatn relaxes things below, its wide-open s never tightening, so the heading stands out.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-wix-madefor-display: Sniglet has a ruler-drawn, constant-width line and short-stopped terminals. That makes it the one to grab attention, while Wix Madefor Display, with gently flared curve ends that stay apart, does the quiet reading work.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-wix-madefor-text: Wix Madefor Text offers easy-to-read open terminals. Above it, Sniglet's single-width stroke and commanding, level beat do the leading, while the text stays professional, contemporary and quietly in the background.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-zen-kaku-gothic-antiqu: Zen Kaku Gothic Antique reads modern and clean, with smooth bends. Sniglet does the attention-grabbing best, with blunt terminals and a level beat, while the text is best at leading the eye around each unobstructed curve.
